description: Diff runtime snapshots and project downstream effects. Call get_runtime_status first. Call once for baseline, then again after a re-render to see what changed and how data flows. Set verify=true to also run Verified Projection.

componentName.description: Filter to a specific component by name (case-insensitive, partial match)

entryFile.description: Absolute path to the entry React component file (e.g., /path/to/App.tsx)

verify.description: If true, also run Verified Projection on changed components to annotate verification status

name: trigger_projection
